description.text:
Rocket by Balls Brothers, offers you a high-quality bar with a traditional and informal atmosphere. We are perfect for lunch and dinner, or after-work drinks. We offer you a food menu packed with classic British dishes, a wine menu full of impeccable and quality wines and a fabulous range of cocktails, all served up in a casual and informal atmosphere.

You can enjoy our Gin Infusions class, where you get to create and experiment with your favourite botanicals, garnishes and mixers all held within a great environment. Perfect for celebrations and office parties alike.

We offer reservations for private events, intimate lunches or areas after-work - whatever the occasion, Rocket by Balls Brothers is a great bar to spend time in with friends and colleagues alike.

For reservations book online at www.ballsbrothers.co.uk or call us on 020 3200 2022.

We look forward to welcoming you down soon.

Location: Churchill Place
